decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certifies that on 28 September 2004, the proposed side/rear extension to in-fill the lightwell, as shown on drawings CL5 and CL6, dated March 2004, received 23 August 2004, which increases the original volume of the house at 24 Beverley Road, W4 2LP by 17.64m3, dimensions:  Width = 1.8m, Depth = 3.2m, Height = 3.4m, would be lawful in terms of section 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended)

Condition : 2 - If work commences on any other extension (including the basement) before the side rear extension subject to this decision is completed, this may invalidate the lawful development certificate for the side rear extension.  As a result your client may be liable to enforcement action which may threaten any loan secured against the property and may result in prosecution attracting a fine, if successful, not exceeding ?20 000.  It is likely also to make the property difficult to sell.
description: Certificate of lawfulness for erection to side elevation to dwellinghouse.
